Compound complex Wishart models (R6)

Source: R/models.R
CompoundWishart.Rd

R6 class for the compound truncated Poisson (CTPCW) and compound geometric (CGCW) complex Wishart laws of Ferreira, Nascimento and Frery (2022); see dctpcw(). Parameters are estimated by the expectation-maximisation (EM) algorithm, treating the number of scatterers \(N\) as missing data:

  • E-step: \(\hat N_i = E(N \mid S_i)\);

  • M-step: \(\hat\Sigma = \bar S / (L \bar N)\) and \(\hat\lambda/(1 - e^{-\hat\lambda}) = \bar N\) (CTPCW) or \(\hat p = 1/\bar N\) (CGCW).

The Shannon entropy has no closed form and is approximated by Monte Carlo.

References

Ferreira, J. A., Nascimento, A. D. C. and Frery, A. C. (2022). PolSAR models with multimodal intensities. Remote Sensing, 14(20), 5083. doi:10.3390/rs14205083

CompoundWishart$new()

Create a compound Wishart model.

Usage

CompoundWishart$new(
  counting = c("poisson", "geometric"),
  Sigma = diag(3) + (0+0i),
  L = 4,
  lambda = 1,
  p = 0.5
)

Arguments

counting

"poisson" (CTPCW) or "geometric" (CGCW).

Sigma

Hermitian positive definite matrix.

L

Number of looks of each component.

lambda, p

Parameter of the counting law.

Examples

set.seed(1)
S <- rctpcw(200, lambda = 1.5, Sigma = polsar_example_sigma("forest"), L = 4)
m <- CompoundWishart$new(counting = "poisson")$fit(S, L = 4)
m$params$lambda
#> [1] 1.462612
m$iterations
#> [1] 33
